subproblem.title: Sobolev inequality for ζχ_G with a Gauss-Green pair (Simon p. 83; parent Step 7 (S), errata E5 and E6)
subproblem.statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, N := n + 1 and p := (n + 1)/n ∈ [1, ∞] (computed in ℝ≥0∞, so p = ∞ when n = 0). There is c > 0 such that for every open U ⊆ ℝ^N, every Lebesgue null-measurable G ⊆ ℝ^N, every Gauss-Green pair (μ, ν) for (U, G) and every K-Lipschitz ζ : ℝ^N → ℝ (K ∈ ℝ≥0) with ζ ≥ 0, compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ U: eLpNorm(χ_G ζ, p, L^N) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(c (∫ ζ dμ + ∫_G |Dζ| dL^N)), where χ_G ζ = G.indicator ζ, eLpNorm(·, ∞) is the essential supremum, and |Dζ(y)| = ‖fderiv ℝ ζ y‖.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (U G : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (ζ : Rn (n + 1) → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ζ y) → eLpNorm (G.indicator ζ) ((n + 1 : ℝ≥0∞) / n) volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (∫ y, ζ y ∂μ + ∫ y in G, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ y‖))
subproblem.natural_proof:
(Implementation note: ContDiffBump.ae_convolution_tendsto_right_of_locallyIntegrable lives in Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.BumpFunction.Convolution and eLpNorm_lim_le_liminf_eLpNorm in Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSpace.Complete; these modules must be imported.)
Source: parent proof Step 7 (Simon, chapter-03.txt lines 689-705, the Sobolev inequality display following (9)), stated here for a single Gauss-Green pair (the consumers apply it to (μ, ν) for (U, E) and to (μ, −ν) for (U, U ∖ E), erratum E5). The Lipschitz Sobolev inequality, including the one-dimensional L^∞ form of erratum E6, is supplied by sibling lipschitz_sobolev. Notation: N = n + 1; p := (n + 1)/n ∈ ℝ≥0∞; ‖·‖_p := eLpNorm(·, p, L^N); Du := fderiv ℝ u, and for u : ℝ^N → ℝ, |Du(y)| is the operator norm, equal to |∇u(y)| where ∇u(y) ∈ ℝ^N is the gradient; for σ > 0, φ_σ is the normalized smooth bump at 0 with radii σ/2 < σ (C^∞, ≥ 0, even, spt φ_σ ⊆ B̄_σ(0), ∫ φ_σ = 1; Mathlib ContDiffBump.normed); (f * g)(y) := ∫ f(y − z) g(z) dz; cthickening(δ, T) is the closed δ-neighbourhood of T (compact if T is compact; empty if T = ∅).

0. (The constant.) Let c > 0 be the constant of sibling lipschitz_sobolev for this n: ‖w‖_p ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(c ∫ |Dw| dL^N) for every Lipschitz w : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support. It depends only on n.

Fix U, G, μ, ν, ζ, K as in the statement; let M := sup ζ and T := tsupport ζ (compact, T ⊆ U). Choose σ₀ ∈ (0, 1] with K' := cthickening(2σ₀, T) ⊆ U (Mathlib IsCompact.exists_cthickening_subset_open). K' is compact, so μ(K') < ∞ and L^N(K') < ∞. Put R := ∫ ζ dμ + ∫_G |Dζ| dL^N; both integrals are finite and non-negative (0 ≤ ζ ≤ M, ζ continuous and supported in T with μ(T) < ∞; |Dζ| ≤ K, Dζ = 0 off T, and Dζ is Borel measurable).

1. (Mollified indicator.) For σ ∈ (0, σ₀) let u_σ := φ_σ * χ_G, u_σ(y) = ∫ φ_σ(y − z) χ_G(z) dz. Then u_σ is C^∞ with 0 ≤ u_σ ≤ 1, ∇u_σ(y) = ∫ ∇φ_σ(y − z) χ_G(z) dz (differentiation under the integral sign; Mathlib HasCompactSupport.hasFDerivAt_convolution_left/right), and |∇u_σ| ≤ ∫ |∇φ_σ| < ∞, so u_σ is Lipschitz. Put w_σ := ζ u_σ: it is Lipschitz (a product of bounded Lipschitz functions) and vanishes outside T, so it has compact support. At every point where ζ is differentiable (L^N-a.e., by Rademacher), Dw_σ = u_σ Dζ + ζ Du_σ, so ∫ |Dw_σ| ≤ ∫ ζ |∇u_σ| + ∫ u_σ |Dζ|.

2. (Key estimate ∫ ζ|∇u_σ| ≤ ∫ ζ̃_σ dμ, where ζ̃_σ(z) := ∫ ζ(y) φ_σ(y − z) dy.) Let g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N be continuous with |g| ≤ ζ pointwise (so g = 0 off T and g has compact support), and put g̃(z) := ∫ g(y) φ_σ(y − z) dy. Then g̃ is C^∞ (differentiation under the integral sign), g̃(z) = 0 unless infDist(z, T) ≤ σ, so tsupport g̃ ⊆ cthickening(σ, T) ⊆ K' ⊆ U and g̃ has compact support; |g̃| ≤ ζ̃_σ; and div g̃(z) = Σ_i ∂_{z_i} ∫ g_i(y) φ_σ(y − z) dy = −∫ ⟨g(y), ∇φ_σ(y − z)⟩ dy. By Fubini (the integrand (y, z) ↦ ⟨g(y), ∇φ_σ(y − z)⟩ χ_G(z) is bounded, measurable, and vanishes unless y ∈ T and |y − z| ≤ σ):
 ∫ ⟨g(y), ∇u_σ(y)⟩ dy = ∫∫ ⟨g(y), ∇φ_σ(y − z)⟩ χ_G(z) dz dy = ∫_G (∫ ⟨g(y), ∇φ_σ(y − z)⟩ dy) dz = −∫_G div g̃(z) dz.
 Since div g̃ = 0 outside tsupport g̃ ⊆ U, ∫_G div g̃ = ∫_{G∩U} div g̃, and the Gauss-Green identity of the pair (g̃ is C¹, has compact support and tsupport g̃ ⊆ U) gives −∫_{G∩U} div g̃ = ∫ ⟨g̃, ν⟩ dμ ≤ ∫ |g̃||ν| dμ ≤ ∫ ζ̃_σ dμ (|ν| = 1 μ-a.e.). Thus ∫ ⟨g, ∇u_σ⟩ ≤ ∫ ζ̃_σ dμ for every such g. Apply this to g_j := ζ ∇u_σ/(|∇u_σ| + 1/j), j ≥ 1 (continuous, |g_j| ≤ ζ): ⟨g_j, ∇u_σ⟩ = ζ|∇u_σ|²/(|∇u_σ| + 1/j) ≥ 0 increases pointwise to ζ|∇u_σ| as j → ∞, so by monotone convergence ∫ ζ|∇u_σ| ≤ ∫ ζ̃_σ dμ.

3. (Limits as σ → 0.) ζ̃_σ(z) − ζ(z) = ∫ (ζ(y) − ζ(z)) φ_σ(y − z) dy, so |ζ̃_σ − ζ| ≤ Kσ; also 0 ≤ ζ̃_σ ≤ M and ζ̃_σ vanishes off K'. As μ(K') < ∞, dominated convergence gives ∫ ζ̃_σ dμ → ∫ ζ dμ. Let σ_j := σ₀/(j + 2). By the Lebesgue differentiation theorem for mollifiers (Mathlib ContDiffBump.ae_convolution_tendsto_right_of_locallyIntegrable; χ_G is locally integrable), u_{σ_j} → χ_G L^N-a.e. Since 0 ≤ u_{σ_j} ≤ 1 and |Dζ| ≤ K 1_T, dominated convergence gives ∫ u_{σ_j}|Dζ| → ∫ χ_G |Dζ| = ∫_G |Dζ|; and w_{σ_j} → ζχ_G = G.indicator ζ L^N-a.e. With steps 1 and 2: for every ε > 0, ∫ |Dw_{σ_j}| ≤ ∫ ζ̃_{σ_j} dμ + ∫ u_{σ_j}|Dζ| ≤ R + ε for all large j.

4. (Conclusion.) By step 0 applied to the compactly supported Lipschitz functions w_{σ_j}: ‖w_{σ_j}‖_p ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(c ∫ |Dw_{σ_j}|). Since w_{σ_j} → G.indicator ζ L^N-a.e. and all these functions are a.e. strongly measurable, Mathlib eLpNorm_lim_le_liminf_eLpNorm (a Fatou-type bound valid for every exponent, including p = ∞) gives ‖G.indicator ζ‖_p ≤ liminf_j ‖w_{σ_j}‖_p ≤ liminf_j ENNReal.ofReal(c ∫ |Dw_{σ_j}|) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(c(R + ε)) for every ε > 0 (step 3). Letting ε → 0 (continuity of ENNReal.ofReal) yields eLpNorm(G.indicator ζ, p, L^N) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(c (∫ ζ dμ + ∫_G |Dζ| dL^N)). ∎
proof_key_steps: Take c from sibling lipschitz_sobolev (exponent (n+1)/n, = ∞ for n = 0).
Mollify the indicator: u_σ = φ_σ * χ_G and w_σ = ζu_σ (Lipschitz, compact support), with ∫|Dw_σ| ≤ ∫ζ|∇u_σ| + ∫u_σ|Dζ|.
Duality with the Gauss-Green identity for the smooth fields g̃ = φ_σ-averages of g, |g| ≤ ζ, plus monotone convergence: ∫ζ|∇u_σ| ≤ ∫ζ̃_σ dμ.
σ_j → 0: ∫ζ̃_σ dμ → ∫ζdμ, u_σ → χ_G a.e., so limsup ∫|Dw_σ| ≤ ∫ζdμ + ∫_G|Dζ|.
Fatou for eLpNorm (eLpNorm_lim_le_liminf_eLpNorm) and lipschitz_sobolev applied to w_{σ_j} give the claim.

audit.reason: The proof establishes the exact inequality with a constant uniform in the data. Mollification, the explicit dual test fields, Gauss–Green and compact-support bounds justify the gradient estimate and Fubini. The limiting argument handles null-measurable indicators and the ∞ endpoint without assuming finite global volume.
